Como está organizado o percurso IA Gener: How is the Generative AI at Work learning path organised?
Tem cinco cursos sequenciais, cada um co: It has five sequential courses, each with six 60-minute sessions (30 hours in total): Course 1, Introduction to Generative AI at Work; Course 2, Productivity with Generative AI; Course 3, AI in Organisational Processes; Course 4, AI Leadership and Implementation; Course 5, Implementing Practical Cases, in which each trainee puts a real case from their own organisation into operation. Every session ends with a Practical Case Lab, which grows from 10 to 40 minutes per session over the learning path. The reference tool is Claude (Anthropic); the concepts are transferable to other generative AI assistants.

Classes have 8 to 14 trainees, in person or live online.
Combina avaliação prática, teste e parti: It combines practical assessment, a test and participation, and the weight of the practical component increases from course to course: 40% in Course 1, 60% in Course 2, 70% in Course 3 and 85% in Courses 4 and 5, with no test: Course 4 includes a final project and Course 5 the implementation of a real case. A pass requires 50% and attendance at 5 of the 6 sessions; in Course 4, 50% and submission of the final project; in Course 5, 50% and presentation of the implemented case.
